name: chatgpt-remote-commander
description: Operate a trusted computer through a private MCP connection, including optional guarded Windows and Linux GNOME/Wayland GUI control.

interface.longDescription: Use a registered ChatGPT Remote Commander app to inspect projects, run approved tools, perform trusted-machine workflows, and optionally control the Windows GUI through screenshot/mouse/keyboard MCP tools.
defaultPrompt: Report this computer's Remote Commander status without changing anything.
Inspect my project and explain what needs attention before making changes.
Use Remote Commander to run the requested trusted-machine workflow.
If GUI Control is enabled, inspect the live desktop with gui_screenshot and perform the requested graphical workflow.
